description: This Java source file defines the class 'LoanTestData' which contains constants, nested classes, and utility methods related to loan testing data, including transaction details, journal entries, installment plans, and various enumerations for loan configurations.

classes.name: LoanTestData
classes.description: A final utility class encapsulating various nested classes, constants, and methods for handling test data related to loans in integration tests.

classes.name: LoanTestData.Transaction
classes.description: Represents a transaction with amount, text type, date, and reversal status.

classes.name: LoanTestData.TransactionExt
classes.description: Extended transaction details including principal, interest, fee, penalty portions, and outstanding amounts.

classes.name: LoanTestData.Journal
classes.description: Represents a journal entry with amount, associated account, and type (debit or credit). Includes static factory methods for creating debit and credit entries.

classes.name: LoanTestData.Installment
classes.description: Details of a loan installment, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, outstanding amounts, due date, and balance.

classes.name: LoanTestData.OutstandingAmounts
classes.description: Aggregate outstanding amounts for principal, interest, fees, penalties, and total.

classes.name: LoanTestData.AmortizationType
classes.description: Constants representing types of amortization methods (e.g., equal installments).

classes.name: LoanTestData.InterestType
classes.description: Constants representing interest calculation types (declining balance, flat).

classes.name: LoanTestData.InterestRecalculationCompoundingMethod
classes.description: Constants for interest recalculation and compounding methods.

classes.name: LoanTestData.RepaymentFrequencyType
classes.description: Constants for repayment frequency units (months, days) with their respective types.

classes.name: LoanTestData.RecalculationRestFrequencyType
classes.description: Constants indicating recalculation frequency options.

classes.name: LoanTestData.InterestCalculationPeriodType
classes.description: Constants for interest calculation periods (daily, same as repayment).

classes.name: LoanTestData.InterestRateFrequencyType
classes.description: Constants defining frequency units for interest rates (months, years, whole term).

classes.name: LoanTestData.TransactionProcessingStrategyCode
classes.description: Constants for transaction processing strategies (e.g., advanced payment allocation).

classes.name: LoanTestData.RescheduleStrategyMethod
classes.description: Constants for rescheduling strategies during loan adjustments.

classes.name: LoanTestData.DaysInYearType
classes.description: Constants for days-in-year conventions for interest calculations.

classes.name: LoanTestData.DaysInMonthType
classes.description: Constants for days-in-month conventions.

classes.name: LoanTestData.FuturePaymentAllocationRule
classes.description: Constants for rules on how future payments are allocated.

classes.name: LoanTestData.SupportedInterestRefundTypesItem
classes.description: Constants for supported interest refund types.

classes.name: LoanTestData.DaysInYearCustomStrategy
classes.description: Constants for custom leap-year handling strategies.
